description: This file defines the Workflow class for acceptance testing within the SuiteCRM project. It contains methods for navigating the workflow management page, selecting modules, adding conditions, and setting condition parameters via web UI interactions.

classes.name: Workflow
classes.description: Acceptance test helper class for workflow management, extending AcceptanceTester to perform UI interactions related to workflows.

methods.name: navigateToWorkflow
methods.description: Navigates to the workflow management page in the SuiteCRM admin interface.

methods.name: selectWorkflowModule
methods.description: Selects a module in the workflow configuration.

methods.name: addCondition
methods.description: Adds a new condition row in the workflow setup.

methods.name: setConditionModuleField
methods.description: Sets the module and field for a specific condition row.

methods.name: setConditionOperator
methods.description: Sets the operator and value type for a specific condition.

methods.name: setConditionOperatorDateTimeValue
methods.description: Sets a date/time value for a condition using a date picker.

methods.name: getLastConditionRowNumber
methods.description: Returns the index of the last condition row currently present.
